    hystWindow  : REAL;

    loAlarm     : BOOL := FALSE;

    localError := TRUE;
    localStatus := 16#8001;
END_IF;

IF hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel) THEN
    localError := TRUE;
    localStatus := 16#8002;
END_IF;

// Set output based on parameter validation
error := localError;
status := localStatus;

// If no error, evaluate alarm conditions

    IF Value > hiLevel THEN
        hiAlarm := TRUE;
    ELSIF Value < (hiLevel - hystWindow) THEN

    END_IF;

    ELSIF Value > (loLevel + hystWindow) THEN
        loAlarm := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
